description:
Install a solar energy array on the sample house in NCH DreamPlan Home Design Software.

Your goal is to:
1. Open the 'Sample House' project if not already loaded.
2. Locate the 'Solar Panel' object in the library (look under Exterior > Accessories or Roof items).
3. Install an array of at least 4 solar panels on one of the main roof sections of the house.
4. Ensure the panels are placed directly on the roof surface (following the slope) and arranged in a grid or row.
5. Save the project as 'solar_project.dplan' in the Documents folder (C:\Users\Docker\Documents\solar_project.dplan).
